summary: Frontend-only retest of the /statement-settings focus-loss bug fix (Field moved to module level). Logged in through real UI as admin/admin123, opened /statement-settings, typed full Arabic strings character-by-character (press_sequentially with delay) into 'صفة الموقّع الافتراضية', 'اسم الموقّع الافتراضي' and 'أرقام الهاتف'. All fields kept focus and accepted the complete text. Save succeeded (success toast) and values persisted after a full page reload (GET/PUT /api/statements/settings/{faculty_id}).
critical_code_review_comments: Field inputs in statement-settings.tsx have no testID/data-testid; tests must rely on Arabic placeholders. Consider passing a testID prop per field for stable selectors.

Direct navigation to /statement-settings before auth hydration briefly renders the 'no-permission' screen (403 on API). Non-blocking after real login, but consider waiting for auth hydration before the permission gate.
seed_data_creation: Updated statement settings for the first faculty (كلية الشريعة والقانون): signatory_title='عميد الكلية', registrar_name='أ. محمد سالم بن يحيى', phones='417506 - 417599'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login must be done via the real UI: fill the two placeholders then click text 'تسجيل الدخول' (pressing Enter does NOT submit). Token stored in localStorage under 'token'. Fields on /statement-settings are addressed by Arabic placeholders (e.g. input[placeholder="مسجل الكلية"]).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: Field component was declared inside StatementSettingsScreen, so each state update created a new component type and React unmounted/remounted the TextInput, dropping focus after one keystroke. Fix (Field hoisted to module scope) verified working — continuous typing now retains focus.
